symbols.name: K
symbols.def: The fixed number of nonempty clusters.

symbols.name: Nexp
symbols.def: The positive integer scaling parameter \(N_{\exp}\) in the algebraic criterion.

symbols.name: Sigma
symbols.def: The fixed symmetric rational pilot score matrix supplied as an algebraic optimization input.

symbols.name: T
symbols.def: \(\mathcal T\) is the supplied rooted decomposition tree for \(F\).

symbols.name: B
symbols.def: \(B_t\) is the bag at decomposition node \(t\).

symbols.name: Lbits
symbols.def: The maximum binary encoding length of an entry of \(\Sigma\) and of \(N_{\exp}\).

symbols.name: Ht
symbols.def: \(H_t\) contains the ordered pairs whose covariance scope is charged at \(t\).

symbols.name: DPt
symbols.def: \(D_t(q)\) is the minimum charge below \(t\) among partial partitions represented by state \(q\).

symbols.name: BPt
symbols.def: \(P_t(q)\) records a minimizing legal predecessor or predecessor pair for \(D_t(q)\).

symbols.name: hatSigma
symbols.def: \(\widehat\Sigma\) is estimated before design optimization and is fixed as an input.

symbols.name: Tkill
symbols.def: \(\mathcal T_{\mathrm{kill}}\) joins the two leaf branches at bag \(\{c\}\).

symbols.name: RankHandle
symbols.def: Apply the connectivity-matrix representative-set reduction separately within each fixed bag labeling after all scopes in \(H_t\) have been charged, while retaining completed-label compatibility.

assumptions.condition: \(\forall v\in U,\,\operatorname{Conn}(\mathcal T[\{t\in V(\mathcal T):v\in B_t\}])\).

definitions.name: Connected \(K\)-partition class
definitions.construction: \(\mathfrak C_K(G)=\{\mathcal C=(C_1,\ldots,C_K)\in(2^U)^K:C_1,\ldots,C_K\text{ are pairwise disjoint and nonempty},\ \bigcup_{k=1}^K C_k=U,\text{ and }G[C_k]\text{ is connected for every }k\}\).

definitions.name: Algebraic \(p=1/2\) covariance-scope criterion
definitions.construction: For \(\mathcal C\in\mathfrak C_K(G)\), compute \(L_i(\mathcal C)=\ell_{\mathcal C}(N_G[i])\), \(m_{ii'}(\mathcal C)=|L_i(\mathcal C)\cap L_{i'}(\mathcal C)|\), and \(V(\mathcal C;\Sigma)=N_{\exp}^{-1}\sum_{i,i'\in U}2^{m_{ii'}(\mathcal C)+1}\Sigma_{ii'}\mathbf 1\{m_{ii'}(\mathcal C)>0\}\).

definitions.name: Highest-bag scope assignment
definitions.construction: For every ordered pair \((i,i')\) with \(\Sigma_{ii'}\ne0\), let \(t(i,i')\) be the unique node closest to the root among bags containing \(N_G[i]\cup N_G[i']\), and set \(H_t=\{(i,i'):t(i,i')=t\}\).

definitions.name: Exact connected-design MILP
definitions.construction: Use binary \(x_{vk}\) and \(r_{vk}\), integer \(s_k\) and \(h_{vk}\), nonnegative flows \(f^k_{uv}\) on both orientations of \(E\), binary neighborhood-occurrence variables \(u_{ik}\), overlap variables \(b_{ii'k}\), and one-hot variables \(z_{ii'q}\) for \(q=0,\ldots,K\). Impose \(\sum_kx_{vk}=1\), \(s_k=\sum_vx_{vk}\ge1\), \(\sum_vr_{vk}=1\), \(r_{vk}\le x_{vk}\), \(0\le h_{vk}\le Rr_{vk}\), \(h_{vk}\le s_k\), \(h_{vk}\ge s_k-R(1-r_{vk})\), \(0\le f^k_{uv}\le Rx_{uk}\), \(0\le f^k_{uv}\le Rx_{vk}\), and \(\sum_{u:vu\in E}f^k_{vu}-\sum_{u:uv\in E}f^k_{uv}=h_{vk}-x_{vk}\). Encode neighborhood occurrence by \(u_{ik}\ge x_{vk}\) for every \(v\in N_G[i]\) and \(u_{ik}\le\sum_{v\in N_G[i]}x_{vk}\). Encode overlap by \(b_{ii'k}\le u_{ik}\), \(b_{ii'k}\le u_{i'k}\), and \(b_{ii'k}\ge u_{ik}+u_{i'k}-1\). Impose \(\sum_{q=0}^Kz_{ii'q}=1\) and \(\sum_{q=0}^Kqz_{ii'q}=\sum_kb_{ii'k}\), and minimize \(N_{\exp}^{-1}\sum_{i,i'}\sum_{q=1}^K2^{q+1}\Sigma_{ii'}z_{ii'q}\).

definitions.name: Completed-label connectivity state
definitions.construction: At node \(t\), a state is \(q=(\lambda,\pi,c)\), where \(\lambda:B_t\to\{1,\ldots,K\}\), \(\pi\) is a partition of \(B_t\) refining the fibers of \(\lambda\), and \(c\in\{0,1\}^K\). Each block of \(\pi\) is one connected component of the processed \(G\)-edges meeting \(B_t\). The invariant is that every processed component of an unfinished label meets \(B_t\); \(c_k=1\) exactly when the unique connected component of label \(k\) has been closed and label \(k\) is absent from \(B_t\).

definitions.name: Exact nice-decomposition recurrence
definitions.construction: At an empty leaf initialize \(\varnothing,\varnothing,\mathbf 0_K\) with value zero. At an introduce-vertex node, assign a label with \(c_k=0\) and create its singleton block. At an introduce-edge node for \(e\in E\), merge the two endpoint blocks exactly when their labels agree; for \(e\in E_F\setminus E\), leave the connectivity partition unchanged. At a forget node, delete the vertex from its block; if its whole block disappears while another block of the same label remains, reject, and if it was the last active block set \(c_k=1\). At a join, require the same bag labeling, merge child partitions by transitive closure, require \(c_k=0\) in both children for every label active in the bag, and for an absent label reject \(c_k=1\) in both children while otherwise taking the logical disjunction. Add exactly the local costs indexed by \(H_t\). At the empty root accept exactly \((\varnothing,\varnothing,\mathbf1_K)\).

definitions.name: Rational table and backpointer certificate
definitions.construction: \(\operatorname{Cert}(G,K,\Sigma,\mathcal T)\) lists every finite \((t,q,D_t(q),P_t(q))\), the locally charged rational summands for \(H_t\), the accepted root state, and the recovered labels obtained by following backpointers from the root.

definitions.name: Four-cycle reversal witness
definitions.construction: Take \(N_{\exp}=1\), \(G=G_4\), \(K=2\), \(\Sigma=\Sigma_4\), and compare \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{sing}}\) with \(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{bal}}\).

definitions.name: Zhu two-cluster cut score
definitions.construction: \(H(\mathcal C;\Sigma)=\sum_{i<i':\ell_{\mathcal C}(i)\ne\ell_{\mathcal C}(i')}\{R\,\mathbf1(\{i,i'\}\in E)\Sigma_{ii'}-\Sigma_{ii'}\}\), which is Zhu et al.'s two-cluster surrogate up to its positive factor.

definitions.name: Representative-set compression handle
definitions.construction: For each fixed \((t,\lambda,c)\), form the connectivity matrix on the label-refining partitions \(\pi\), retain a minimum-cost representative basis after charging \(H_t\), and test whether this basis is preserved by forget and completed-label join compatibility.

statements.statement: For every finite connected \(G\) and every \(2\le K\le R\), \(\mathfrak C_K(G)\ne\varnothing\).
statements.justification: This guarantees that the finite design optimization and both exact formulations have an attainable optimum.
statements.gap: Connected-partition existence is standard; it is included only to close the optimization domain, not as a novelty claim.
statements.consumer: The MILP and dynamic program can report an optimum rather than an infeasibility artifact.

statements.statement: For every \((i,i')\) with \(\Sigma_{ii'}\ne0\), the scope \(N_G[i]\cup N_G[i']\) is a clique of \(F\), occurs in at least one bag of \(\mathcal T\), and has a unique highest containing bag. Consequently its contribution to \(V\) is determined by that bag labeling and is charged exactly once by \(H_t\).
statements.justification: The lemma converts a non-pairwise covariance objective into local bag potentials without approximation.
statements.gap: Generic connectivity dynamic programs charge vertex or edge weights; Zhu et al.'s factor depends on all labels across a covariance-supported union of exposure neighborhoods.
statements.consumer: It supplies the objective-locality step required by the exact treewidth algorithm.

statements.statement: For every finite connected \(G\), integer \(2\le K\le R\), symmetric rational matrix \(\Sigma\), and positive integer \(N_{\exp}\), projecting any feasible point of \(\mathrm{MILP}(G,K,\Sigma,N_{\exp})\) to its \(x\)-label assignment yields a labeled partition \(\mathcal C=(C_1,\ldots,C_K)\in\mathfrak C_K(G)\). Every labeled \(\mathcal C\in\mathfrak C_K(G)\) has at least one feasible extension to the auxiliary variables, and every such extension has objective exactly \(V(\mathcal C;\Sigma)\). Auxiliary root and flow variables may admit multiple feasible extensions of the same labeled partition; this multiplicity is harmless, and cluster labels are not quotiented by permutations. Consequently the MILP optimum equals \(\min_{\mathcal C\in\mathfrak C_K(G)}V(\mathcal C;\Sigma)\), and projecting any MILP optimizer reconstructs an optimal labeled partition \(\mathcal C^\star\).
statements.justification: Projection and feasible auxiliary extension establish a solver-ready exact formulation for arbitrary finite instances without requiring auxiliary-variable uniqueness, and provide a benchmark for the parameterized algorithm.
statements.gap: Section 3.2 of Zhu et al. explains and justifies omitting its second-order residual-covariance term from graph-cut optimization; no published formulation located globally optimizes the resulting exact rational scope objective over connected nonempty clusters.
statements.consumer: Experimenters with moderate graphs can obtain an auditable exact spatial cluster design rather than a heuristic candidate.

statements.statement: For every finite connected \(G\), integer \(2\le K\le R\), symmetric rational matrix \(\Sigma\), positive integer \(N_{\exp}\), and supplied width-\(w\) nice tree decomposition \(\mathcal T\) of \(F\), the recurrence in \(\mathrm{def:dp-transitions}\) is sound and complete: its accepted root value is \(\min_{\mathcal C\in\mathfrak C_K(G)}V(\mathcal C;\Sigma)\), its backpointers reconstruct an optimizer \(\mathcal C^\star\), and \(\operatorname{Cert}(G,K,\Sigma,\mathcal T)\) is checkable in time polynomial in its displayed table and bit length. There are at most \(S_{w,K}\) states per bag, and a conservative implementation runs in \(O\!\left((|V(\mathcal T)|+R^2)S_{w,K}^2\operatorname{poly}(R,K,w,L_{\mathrm{bits}})\right)\) bit operations and uses \(O\!\left(|V(\mathcal T)|S_{w,K}\operatorname{poly}(R,K,w,L_{\mathrm{bits}})\right)\) bits.
statements.justification: This is the theorem-level kernel: exact connected-design optimization becomes fixed-parameter tractable on sparse covariance-scope interactions and returns a reproducible certificate.
statements.gap: Casel et al. handle connected partitions with size bookkeeping; they do not handle this nonlinear scope criterion, completed-label closure, exact rational local charges, or certificate reconstruction.
statements.consumer: Spatial and marketplace teams can exploit sparse local covariance to certify the globally best connected clustering before randomization.

statements.statement: On \(G_{\mathrm{kill}}=a-c-b\) with \(K=2\), \(\Sigma=\operatorname{diag}(1,0,1)\), and \(\mathcal T_{\mathrm{kill}}\), a join state with bag label \(\lambda(c)=2\) rejects the two children that have each completed absent label \(1\). The analogous local join with label \(1\) active on the separator \(c\) accepts the transitive-closure merge of the two label-\(1\) components.
statements.justification: The width-one witness isolates the exact join error that would falsely certify a disconnected cluster.
statements.gap: The generic prose correctness argument in Casel et al. does not state the completed-label flag invariant needed when part sizes are not prescribed.
statements.consumer: It is a minimal unit certificate for implementations and for the soundness induction at join nodes.

statements.statement: The eigenvalues of \(\Sigma_4\) are \(121/100,99/100,99/100,81/100\), so it is positive definite and entrywise nonnegative. With \(N_{\exp}=1\), every connected balanced split minimizes Zhu et al.'s Section 3.2 two-cluster cut surrogate and \(H(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{bal}};\Sigma_4)=29/50<59/100=H(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{sing}};\Sigma_4)\), whereas \(V(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{sing}};\Sigma_4)=826/25=33.04<968/25=38.72=V(\mathcal C_{\mathrm{bal}};\Sigma_4)\). Therefore exact minimization of \(V\) strictly improves on every surrogate-minimizing balanced split on this instance, even within the optional entrywise-nonnegative regime.
statements.justification: The exact arithmetic proves that optimizing the published surrogate can select the worse full-risk connected design even on a four-cycle.
statements.gap: Section 3.2 of Zhu et al. explains and justifies omitting the second-order residual-covariance term, but does not exhibit a connected design for which this omission reverses the full-criterion ordering.
statements.consumer: The witness tells practitioners when candidate reranking cannot substitute for global exact optimization.

statements.statement: For every \(\mathcal C\in\mathfrak C_K(G)\), \(|V(\mathcal C;\widehat\Sigma)-V(\mathcal C;\Sigma)|\le 2^{K+1}N_{\exp}^{-1}\|\widehat\Sigma-\Sigma\|_{1,\mathrm{ord}}\). Therefore \(0\le V(\widehat{\mathcal C};\Sigma)-V(\mathcal C^\star;\Sigma)\le 2^{K+2}N_{\exp}^{-1}\|\widehat\Sigma-\Sigma\|_{1,\mathrm{ord}}\).
statements.justification: The deterministic envelope translates pilot covariance accuracy into true-criterion design regret without margin or optimizer-uniqueness assumptions.
statements.gap: Viviano proves pilot-regret for a different network-design objective; Zhu et al.'s iterative covariance design has no displayed ordered-entry perturbation guarantee.
statements.consumer: A pilot study can report a numerical upper bound on the loss from deploying its plug-in exact partition.

statements.statement: Can the handle in \(\mathrm{def:rank-handle}\) replace the Bell-number family of label-refining partitions by representative bases and yield a deterministic \(2^{O(Kw)}\operatorname{poly}(R,L_{\mathrm{bits}})\)-time exact algorithm while preserving completed-label join compatibility, rational local-scope costs, and backpointer certification?
statements.justification: A single-exponential dependence would determine whether exact covariance-aware design is practical beyond very small interaction width.
statements.gap: Bodlaender et al. prove representative reduction for standard weighted connectivity extension queries, not simultaneous labeled connectivity with nonlinear bag charges and completed-label flags.
statements.consumer: Larger sparse spatial networks would become certifiably optimizable without changing the covariance-scope criterion.

sampling_model.design: The optimization input is \((G,K,\Sigma,N_{\exp})\), and the output is a labeled nonempty \(G\)-connected \(K\)-partition minimizing \(V\).
sampling_model.treatment: No assignment law is imposed by the optimization theorems; the coefficient \(2^{m+1}\mathbf 1\{m>0\}\) is frozen as part of the algebraic input criterion.
sampling_model.overlap: No overlap condition is imposed by the optimization theorems.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The rational pilot matrix \(\widehat\Sigma\) is fixed before optimization, and the deterministic regret theorem compares it with \(\Sigma\).

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: Appendix B.1 proves Theorem 1's residual decomposition, while Section 3.2 explains and justifies omitting its second-order residual-covariance term from the graph-cut optimization.
Their dynamic program constructs connected parts of prescribed sizes on bounded-treewidth graphs.
Their rank-based method compresses partition states for standard weighted connectivity problems.
Their worst-case cluster design is a penalized min-cut computed through semidefinite optimization.
Their pilot-based network design has oracle-regret guarantees for another variance criterion.
Their robust design optimizes over assignment covariance matrices by SDP and randomized rounding.
Their spatial cluster construction is rate-optimal under decaying interference and supports asymptotic inference.

tldr: Appendix B.1 of Zhu et al. supplies the imported \(p=1/2\) residual-covariance multiplier \(2^{m+1}\mathbf 1\{m>0\}\); thereafter \(V\) is an algebraic symmetric-rational optimization input. The project supplies an exact general MILP and a sound-complete fixed-parameter dynamic program on the covariance-scope interaction graph, with completed-label connectivity states, once-only scope charges, an exact rational optimum, and a checkable backpointer certificate. A four-cycle shows that the Section 3.2 surrogate can reverse the exact ordering even with entrywise-nonnegative \(\Sigma\), and ordered-entry pilot error yields an explicit criterion-regret bound.

project_justification.gap: Appendix B.1 of Zhu et al. proves Theorem 1, whereas Section 3.2 explains and justifies omitting its second-order residual-covariance term from graph-cut optimization; generic connected-partition algorithms do not supply the scope localization, closure invariant, exact rational arithmetic, or reconstruction certificate needed to optimize the imported \(p=1/2\) criterion.
project_justification.niche: For a symmetric rational objective of the form \(V\), covariance support can induce an interaction graph of moderate treewidth even though connected design remains globally coupled.
project_justification.fill: The MILP covers every finite rational instance without covariance-shape restrictions, and the sound-complete treewidth algorithm certifies and reconstructs the exact optimum; the reversal witness and perturbation theorem establish why exactness matters and how pilot error propagates.

related_work: Appendix B.1 of Zhu et al. proves their Theorem 1 residual decomposition; under its repeated-outcome residual setup, the fair-coin specialization supplies the factor \(2^{m_{ii'}(\mathcal C)+1}\mathbf 1\{m_{ii'}(\mathcal C)>0\}\) and hence the residual-covariance expression \(N_{\exp}^{-1}\sum_{i,i'\in U}2^{m_{ii'}(\mathcal C)+1}\Sigma_{ii'}\mathbf 1\{m_{ii'}(\mathcal C)>0\}=V(\mathcal C;\Sigma)\). That calculation is imported background rather than a theorem target. Section 3.2 explains and justifies omitting the associated second-order term from the graph-cut objective. Zhu et al.'s Assumption 2 is covariance decay, not entrywise nonnegativity; entrywise nonnegativity is an additional regime used in Proposition 2 and in the four-cycle witness here, but neither exact optimization theorem requires it. Casel, Giannopoulou, and Niklanovits provide the closest connected-partition dynamic program, whose forget and join logic informs the active-component invariant but whose objective and counters differ. Bodlaender, Cygan, Kratsch, and Nederlof supply the partition-state language and the possible representative-set strengthening. Viviano and coauthors optimize a worst-case penalized cut criterion rather than the pilot-specific scope risk. Thiyageswaran and coauthors optimize a robust assignment-covariance criterion by semidefinite relaxation and rounding, not an exact connected partition. Viviano's two-wave design supplies the adjacent pilot-to-oracle regret template. Leung supplies the spatial cluster-randomization inference benchmark after a design is chosen. Holtz and coauthors document the interference-bias and power cost in Airbnb pricing experiments that makes an auditable covariance-aware clustering decision operationally relevant.
technical_internal_limitation: The parameter is the treewidth of \(F\), not of \(G\). Dense pilot covariance makes every relevant exposure-scope union a clique and can force \(w\) to be of order \(R\), leaving the MILP as the exact fallback and removing practical fixed-parameter advantage.
honest_scope: The \(p=1/2\) multiplier is imported from Zhu et al.'s Appendix B.1 and is not a theorem contribution. The MILP exactness, dynamic-program soundness and completeness induction, reconstruction certificate, and perturbation bounds concern the already-defined rational objective \(V\) and require no potential-outcome model, assignment law, positive semidefiniteness, entrywise nonnegativity, or positive trace. The four-cycle separation additionally verifies positive definiteness and entrywise nonnegativity, placing the reversal inside the optional regime used in Zhu et al.'s Proposition 2. The delicate unresolved step is the join and forget induction for labels that disappear from a separator. Replacing every exposure neighborhood by the singleton \(\{i\}\) reduces the criterion to \(4N_{\exp}^{-1}\sum_k\sum_{i,i'\in C_k}\Sigma_{ii'}\), the spatial-correlation expression in Zhu et al.; for \(K=1\) it reduces to their global residual value. Rank-based single-exponential compression remains the open-ended question.
seeds: Exact rational optimization of the full second-order residual criterion over connected \(K\)-partitions by a general MILP and an interaction-treewidth dynamic program with a checkable reconstruction certificate.
An order-equivalence frontier for Zhu et al.'s cut surrogate and the full scope criterion, paired with a generic family of strict reversals outside the frontier.
Exact connected-partition optimization when exactly \(r\) of the \(K\) clusters are treated, using hypergeometric exposure factors and allocation-count state augmentation.

seed_details.opportunity: Appendix B.1 proves the exact residual decomposition, but Section 3.2 explains and justifies omitting the second-order term from the graph-cut optimization.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace pairwise cut weights by one locally charged factor for each covariance-supported exposure scope, then enforce global connectedness with separator states.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Casel, Giannopoulou, and Niklanovits because their bounded-treewidth routine already handles connected partitions.
seed_details.rebuttal: Their state tracks prescribed sizes and processed connectivity on the objective graph; it neither localizes Zhu et al.'s covariance-scope factors on a larger interaction graph nor proves exact rational objective charging and certification.

seed_details.opportunity: Section 3.2 gives the rationale for omitting the second-order residual-covariance term but no condition under which the surrogate and exact criterion rank connected partitions identically.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Retain the discarded multi-label factors and compare their partition-wise difference with the cut score.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Zhu et al.'s Section 3.2 omission argument because the neglected term is treated as secondary to the graph-cut objective.
seed_details.rebuttal: An order argument about component magnitudes does not preserve rankings over a finite design class; the explicit \(C_4\) instance reverses the two orderings.

seed_details.opportunity: The displayed residual expansion substitutes independent fair cluster coins, while complete randomization of exactly \(r\) clusters changes every joint exposure probability.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Replace Bernoulli powers by hypergeometric probabilities indexed by the union and intersection of the two exposure-label sets.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from standard complete-randomization covariance algebra because only a binomial probability changes.
seed_details.rebuttal: Joint all-treated and all-control exposure events depend on two scope cardinalities and feasibility under \(r\), changing both the local potential and the optimization state.

seed_details.seed: Pilot covariance stability and selected-design regret
seed_details.opportunity: The iterative covariance update has no deterministic uniform perturbation or selected-design regret guarantee.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Uniformly envelope the design-dependent coefficient of each ordered covariance entry before applying the two-minimizer comparison.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the triangle inequality and the standard plug-in argmin lemma.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection is substantially correct for a standalone paper; the bound is retained only as a robustness theorem supporting the exact optimizer.

seed_details.opportunity: The exact formula is specialized to \(p=1/2\), although treatment proportion can be a design choice under network propagation.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Keep the two asymmetric factors \(p^{-m}\) and \((1-p)^{-m}\) through the scope-cost derivation.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Zhu et al.'s pre-substitution formula because arbitrary \(p\) already appears there.
seed_details.rebuttal: The objection holds for independent unequal coins; without jointly optimizing \(p\) or deriving a new certificate this is only a corollary.

seed_details.opportunity: Partition states give a Bell-number dependence, while rank-based connectivity compression may reduce the width exponent.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Define representativity after conditioning on bag labels and already charged nonlinear scope costs.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from the rank-based reduce operator because the states are ordinary connectivity partitions.
seed_details.rebuttal: The nonlinear label-scope costs and simultaneous connectivity of \(K\) labeled parts change the extension relation, so preservation under representative reduction is not automatic.

seed_details.opportunity: Treewidth of the geographic graph can be small even when covariance scopes clique-complete into a dense interaction graph.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Construct a family with \(\operatorname{tw}(G)=1\) whose scope objective encodes a hard dense partition problem.
seed_details.red_team: A hardness result parameterized only by \(\operatorname{tw}(G)\) says little because dense covariance visibly destroys locality.
seed_details.rebuttal: A sharp lower bound would certify that the interaction graph, rather than the geographic graph, is the necessary tractability parameter, but the reduction was not sufficiently mature for this core.

seed_details.opportunity: Buyer-mediated substitution and complementarity can produce signed covariance contributions outside entrywise-nonnegative spatial models.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Fold buyer consideration sets into seller scopes, then determine when signed local charges remain certifiably optimizable.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from Pouget-Abadie et al.'s correlation-clustering formulation for bipartite experiments.
seed_details.rebuttal: That formulation optimizes an exposure-variance proxy and a heuristic, not the covariance-weighted doubly robust residual criterion with connected seller clusters.

seed_details.seed: Worst-case robust covariance design on connected partitions
seed_details.opportunity: Worst-case network designs use cut or semidefinite objectives, leaving exact connected partitioning under a structured covariance uncertainty set open.
seed_details.first_changed_proof_step: Dualize the covariance uncertainty set before localizing its support function on a tree decomposition.
seed_details.red_team: Immediate from recent covariance-matrix SDP designs because robustification already yields a convex objective.
seed_details.rebuttal: The 2026 covariance-design paper substantially occupies the robust-design direction, and the connected-partition restriction alone is not a sufficient delta.
